turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, how may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hey, How dare you issue me a code that does not work!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am livid right now

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand your frustration, I'll do my best to help you right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I have your name?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My name is Norman Bouchard

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Norman Bouchard.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you happen to know when you received the code?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I got this code 5 days ago! Why cant I use it? I had my eyes set on these boots but the moment i input the code and it said invalid! My heart was broken.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A promo code has been created.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There was a mistake in the system. I'm very sorry for the frustration.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A promo code has been created.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have generated a new promocode for you: MC9MS

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This one should definitely work on your boots.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh yes I will take this new code and my rage will be calmed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: As long as I can get these boots for a discount.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. Is there anything else you need?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, enjoy the rest of your day and those boots!
